items.summary: Recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private and authorize no additional spend, monetization expansion, or public launch this cycle. Supported revenue is $4.92 commission on 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items for 2026-09-21; 629 clicks and all 28 ordered items are under tracking_id "other", while named site IDs show zero orders and commission. Attributed site income is therefore $0 in the available report and revenue claims by site are unsupported. Analytics is unavailable for all 60 registry sites, so sessions, conversion rates, CAC, payback, and cost-to-learn are not calculable. AI usage from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-22 is $745.413324 across 4,431 calls, including 139 errors; this is observability only and does not establish return. Contribution margin, infrastructure/domain spend, total operating spend, ROI, and forecasts cannot be calculated because site-level revenue reconciliation, traffic/exposure denominators, direct cost allocation, and experiment outcome records are missing. Minimum measurement is affiliate event reconciliation to site and content IDs, site traffic and conversion telemetry, direct cost allocation by site, and experiment exposure plus incremental outcomes. The proposed routing changes are financially neutral and may proceed as reversible task-assignment corrections; they do not authorize production changes or spend.

Recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private and authorize no additional spend, monetization expansion, or public launch this cycle. Site-level revenue, margin, CAC, payback, ROI, and forecasts remain unsupported because attribution and analytics are incomplete. Financially neutral task-routing corrections may proceed as reversible metadata changes only.
